equations.name: B3 ridge VAR
equations.equation: x_{t+1} = b + A x_t + eps_t; ridge 1.0 on standardized features; spectral cap 0.995

equations.name: B5 common-factor AR
equations.equation: x_{t+1,j} = b_j + a_j x_{t,j} + beta_j^T f_t + eps; f_{t+1}=A_f f_t+b_f

equations.name: moving-block interval
equations.equation: resample contiguous blocks within each session; equal-session pooling; no between-session resampling

findings.finding: The primary interval conditions on the five recordings; it does not resample recordings. A recording-level bootstrap gives a wider interval that includes zero.
findings.impact: The reported interval is not an animal-level generalization interval.

findings.finding: B5 uses a globally fixed 10-D PCA basis and a diagonal-plus-rank-10 residual operator; B3 uses a local 500-frame full operator with arbitrary residual rows.
findings.impact: The contrast confounds residual information with adaptivity and capacity.

findings.finding: B6 is a coefficient ablation with inherited coefficients, not a refitted restricted model.
findings.impact: B6 is diagnostic only; B4m/B5 are the clean restrictions.

findings.finding: The loader preserves numeric trace labels as predictors; these are not cell identities and cannot be aligned across recordings.
findings.impact: All analyses are within-recording; no cross-animal neuron alignment.

findings.finding: stateParams rows do not match trace rows in sessions 1 and 3; the field is unused.
findings.impact: No effect on the model, but archive tables are not row-aligned.

findings.finding: The B5 energy deficit coincides with 95% coverage 0.725 versus B3 0.938, while the MSE contrast is negligible.
findings.impact: Energy advantage is partly a spread/calibration contrast, not a mean-accuracy result.
